view.scene_description: A warehouse aisle with tall metal racks filled with red plastic crates. A forklift is parked on the right side of the aisle. Yellow safety posts line the aisle. The floor is concrete, and overhead lights illuminate the space. The perspective suggests movement along the aisle.

objects.label: red plastic crates
objects.observation: Stacked in multiple rows on metal racks lining the left side of the aisle. Crates have ventilation holes and some show labels. They are arranged vertically and appear identical in design. Partially occluded by yellow posts and the camera's perspective.

objects.label: metal shelving racks
objects.observation: Tall, gray metal structures holding the red crates. Extend from the foreground into the background on both sides of the aisle. Have horizontal beams and vertical uprights. Some sections are partially obscured by crates or posts.

objects.label: yellow safety posts
objects.observation: Cylindrical yellow posts positioned at intervals along the aisle edges, near the racks. One is prominently in the foreground on the left. They appear to be freestanding and serve as visual barriers.

objects.label: forklift
objects.observation: Black and orange forklift parked on the right side of the aisle, facing away from the camera. Has a visible logo and control panel. Its forks are down, resting on the floor. Partially occluded by the rack on its left.

objects.label: concrete floor
objects.observation: Smooth, light-gray concrete surface running the length of the aisle. Reflects overhead lighting. Shows some wear and minor debris. Serves as the base for all objects and provides clear pathways.

objects.label: overhead lights
objects.observation: White fluorescent lights mounted on the ceiling, illuminating the aisle. Two are visible, spaced apart. Emit bright, even light. No direct contact with other objects, but their light affects the entire scene.
